title: Integral closure commutes with ind-etale base change
statement: Let $R,B,S$ be commutative rings equipped with ring maps $R\to B$ and $R\to S$. Assume $R\to S$ is ind-etale, meaning that $S$ is a filtered colimit of finitely presented etale $R$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. Let $C\subseteq B$ be the integral closure of $R$ in $B$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Equip $S\otimes_R B$ with its tensor-product algebra structure, $(s\otimes b)(s^{\prime}\otimes b^{\prime})=ss^{\prime}\otimes bb^{\prime}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and let $C_S\subseteq S\otimes_R B$ be the integral closure of $S$ in this algebra. The canonical $S$-algebra map $S\otimes_R C\longrightarrow C_S$, $s\otimes c\longmapsto s\otimes c$, is an isomorphism. No injectivity, domain, Noetherian, finiteness, nonemptiness, or local-ring assumption on these rings is required.

source.place: Tag 0CBF, lemma-integral-closure-commutes-colim-smooth: specialization from a filtered colimit of smooth algebras to a filtered colimit of etale algebras.

proof.text: Choose a filtered etale presentation of $S$ using [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra], and reindex by a nonempty directed set $I$ using [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-category-directed-cofinal]. Use a common universe for its index and ring carriers. Write $a_i:S_i\to S$, $E_i=S_i\otimes_R C$, $D_i=S_i\otimes_R B$, $E=S\otimes_R C$, $D=S\otimes_R B$. Each stage is etale in the geometric sense used by [lem-sfb-integral-closure-etale-base-change]; applying that node, the stage comparison $q_i:E_i\to\overline{S_i}^{\,D_i}$ is an isomorphism with formula $s\otimes c\mapsto s\otimes c$. Its composite $f_i:E_i\to D_i$ is therefore injective with image exactly that integral closure.

source.place: Tag 0CBF, lemma-integral-closure-commutes-colim-smooth, proof; finite-stage case Tag 03GE, lemma-integral-closure-commutes-etale.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-directed-tensor-integral-embedding] to the inclusion $v:C\hookrightarrow B$. Step 1 verifies its two stagewise assumptions. It gives the injective comparison $q:E\to C_S$ with the required pure-tensor formula, and compatibility of the underlying tensor maps with every transition and coprojection.

source.place: Tag 0CBF, lemma-integral-closure-commutes-colim-smooth, proof; finite-stage case Tag 03GE, lemma-integral-closure-commutes-etale.

proof.text: For $x\in C_S$, lift its underlying element to $x_i\in D_i$ by [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-algebras-tensor-elementwise] with $N=B$. Apply [lem-sfb-directed-algebra-tail-base-change] at $i$. The tail $J_i=\{j\mid i\le j\}$ is nonempty and directed with initial index $i$, and its ring colimit is $S$. Put $\varphi_i(s)=s\otimes1$. The specified $\lambda_T,\theta_T$ identify $1\otimes\varphi_i$ with the scalar structure map and $1\otimes x_i$ over $S$ with $x$. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-integral-tensor-generators-colimit-descent] applies on $J_i$ with $B_0=S_i$, $C_0=D_i$, $\varphi_0=\varphi_i$, and the finite singleton $\{x_i\}$; it requires no finite-type assumption on $D_i$. It yields $j\ge i$ where $1\otimes x_i$ is integral over $S_j\otimes_{S_i}S_i$. Under the same $\lambda_{S_j},\theta_{S_j}$, this says exactly that $x_j=(a_{ij}\otimes1)x_i$ in $D_j$ is integral over $S_j$.

source.place: Tag 0CBF, lemma-integral-closure-commutes-colim-smooth, proof; finite-stage case Tag 03GE, lemma-integral-closure-commutes-etale.

proof.text: By step 1 choose $t_j\in E_j$ with $f_j(t_j)=x_j$. Its image $t\in E$ satisfies $q(t)=x$: step 2 gives $f(t)=(a_j\otimes1_B)f_j(t_j)=(a_j\otimes1_B)x_j=(a_i\otimes1_B)x_i=x$ in $D$, using $a_j a_{ij}=a_i$; the subring inclusion $C_S\hookrightarrow D$ detects this equality. Hence $q$ is surjective and injective. The inverse of this bijective $S$-algebra map preserves operations by applying the injective map $q$, so $q$ is the claimed isomorphism. Zero rings and noninjective transitions require no exception.
